title: New crate: uuencoding-multi (multi-part UUencode reassembly)
description:
Multi-part UUencode is a message sequencing protocol layered on top of UUencoding. Multiple email or Usenet messages each carry one part of a single encoded file; a reassembler collects them, orders them, and feeds the concatenated byte stream to the UUdecoder.

This is a SEPARATE concern from uuencoding (MIME-ksl), which handles single-message encode/decode. This crate depends on uuencoding; uuencoding does not depend on this crate.

Scope:
- Parse 'part X of M' subject line conventions (many formats in the wild)
- Represent a collection of parts as an ordered set
- Detect missing parts
- Detect and parse TOC parts (part 0 or part 1 listing filenames and sizes)
- Reassemble the ordered byte stream
- Feed reassembled bytes to uuencoding::decode()
- No dependency on mime-tree (callers extract subject and body bytes themselves)

Does NOT handle:
- MIME parsing (caller's job, use mime-tree)
- Fetching or storing messages (caller's job)
- yEnc multi-part (different encoding entirely)

Status: PLANNED. Do not start until MIME-ksl (uuencoding crate) is complete and published.

Blocked by: MIME-ksl epic completion.
